verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਨਾਉ ਬੂਠਤ ਸੇ ਜੋਊ ਬਚੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲੋ ਬੂਡ ਗਏ ਪਾਛੇ ਪਛਤਾਯੋ ਰਹਿ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise naau booThat se jouoo bachai soiee bhalo boodd ge paachhe pachhataayo reh jaat hai ||

en.bdb: Blessed are those who are saved from a capsizing boat. If drowned, there would be nothing but repentance.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਘਰ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਗ ਜੋਹੀ ਬਚੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲੋ ਜਰ ਬੁਝੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਕਛੁ ਬਸੁ ਨ ਬਸਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise ghar laagai aag johee bachai soiee bhalo jar bujhai paachhai kachh bas na basaat hai ||

en.bdb: All those who escape from a burning house are blessed people. Nothing can be done if one is burnt into ashes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਚੋਰ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਾਗੇ ਜੋਈ ਰਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲੋ ਸੋਇ ਗਏ ਰੀਤੋ ਘਰ ਦੇਖੈ ਉਠ ਪਾ੍ਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise chor laage jaage joiee rahai soiee bhalo soi ge reeto ghar dhekhai uTh paarat hai ||

en.bdb: As one wakes up when the thief is committing theft, whatever is left behind by him is bonus and blessing. Otherwise one would find the house empty in the morning.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਗੁਰੁ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਆਵੈ ਪਵੈ ਮੋਖ ਪਦਵੀ ਨਤਰ ਬਿਲਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੫॥੬੫॥
verses.translit_en: taise a(n)t kaal gur charan saran aavai pavai mokh padhavee natar bilalaat hai ||35||65||

en.bdb: Similarly if a wayward person comes to the refuge of Guru even at the near end of his life, he can achieve a state of emancipation. Otherwise he would fall in the hands of angels of death and keep wailing. (69)
